candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care → Case Management/Continuity of Care: coordinate follow-up across settings, facilitate referrals and appointments, provide discharge planning, and adapt care delivery to client needs and available resources.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — early individualized follow-up after heart-failure hospitalization
candidate.educational_objective: Plan early heart-failure transitional follow-up with structured contact within 7 days as a desired goal while individualizing the method of contact to client risk and care access.

options.A: Arrange structured contact within 7 days after discharge as a desired goal, using an in-person, video, or telephone approach individualized to the client's risk and available care options.
options.B: Delay all follow-up for at least 1 month because early contact does not contribute to heart-failure transition planning.
options.C: Require every client to return for an in-person clinic visit within 24 hours because telephone or video follow-up is not acceptable.
options.D: Use early contact only for clients discharged to skilled nursing facilities, not for clients returning home.

candidate.rationale: The AHA/ACC/HFSA guideline identifies early outpatient follow-up as a central element of heart-failure transitional care and states that structured contact within 7 days of hospital discharge is a desired goal. It also states that timing and delivery method—including in-person, video, or telephone contact—should be individualized according to patient risk and available care-delivery options. Therefore, A is correct. B delays an emphasized transition strategy, C invents a universal 24-hour in-person requirement, and D incorrectly restricts early follow-up by discharge destination.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Directly supports a desired structured-contact goal within 7 days and individualized selection of in-person, video, or telephone follow-up after heart-failure hospitalization.
candidate.source_document_title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
candidate.source_locator: Section 9.6, Integration of Care: Transitions and Team-Based Approaches → Recommendation-Specific Supportive Text 4: early outpatient follow-up is a central element of transitional care; structured contact within 7 days of hospital discharge is a desired goal; timing and method of delivery (in-person clinic, video, or telephone) should be individualized based on patient risk and available care-delivery options.
candidate.source_organization: American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology/Heart Failure Society of America
candidate.stem: A client is discharged after hospitalization for worsening heart failure. Which follow-up plan best aligns with the AHA/ACC/HFSA transitional-care guidance?
